page_title: AUG 1-1 KOL | Augsburg v FC Koln 31/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Soren Storks has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
90+3' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) is booked for saying more than Soren Storks was willing to tolerate.
89' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) attempts to discuss the decision with Soren Storks, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
88' A substitution has been made. Ruben Vargas goes off and Pep Biel (Augsburg) comes on.
88' Jess Thorup prepares a substitution. Phillip Tietz is replaced by Sven Michel (Augsburg).

87' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Marvin Schwabe anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
86' Arne Maier (Augsburg) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
83' The game is interrupted. Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
82' Timo Schultz has decided to make a change. Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) replaces Davie Selke.
82' Dion Beljo (Augsburg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Soren Storks blows for a foul.
81' The attendance for today's match is 28000.
79' The referee signals a substitution. Arne Engels (Augsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Fredrik Jensen.
78' Augsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
78' Augsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball goes out of play. Augsburg are awarded a corner kick.

78' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Augsburg.
77' Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
77' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Augsburg.
76' Dion Beljo (Augsburg) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
73' The referee allows time for a substitution. Sargis Adamyan will be replaced by Damion Downs (1. FC Koln).
71' Dion Beljo (Augsburg) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
69' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

65' FC Koln failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

61' A yellow card for a tackle by Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln). Soren Storks doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
60' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.
60' The corner is swung in but Augsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Elvis Rexhbecaj leaves the pitch and Dion Beljo (Augsburg) comes on.
55' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
53' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Soren Storks blows for a foul.
50' A player from FC Koln commits a rough challenge. Soren Storks blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
47' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
46' Half-time substitution. Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) will not participate anymore and Max Finkgrafe is coming on.
46' Jess Thorup makes a half-time substitution. Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) comes on in place of Iago.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+4' Augsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+3' A quickly taken corner by FC Koln.
45+2' FC Koln failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul. Augsburg are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
42' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
38' Marvin Schwabe (1. FC Koln) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
36' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper.
36' The ball is out of play. Augsburg win a corner kick.
33' 1 - 1 It's 1:1! Sargis Adamyan feeds Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
32' The current number of shots on goal is 2:0.
31' Iago (Augsburg) approaches the edge of the box with intent and shoots, but Marvin Schwabe rushes out to narrow the angle and smothers the ball. Good goalkeeping!
29' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
25' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) is caught offside!
25' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Soren Storks no option but to blow his whistle.
21' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
20' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) makes a rough challenge and Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul.
18' 1 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Arne Maier (Augsburg) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom right corner.
16' The resulting set piece from Augsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
15' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) commits a rough challenge and Soren Storks blows his whistle for an infringement.
13' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) sends a wild header high over the bar.
13' The resulting corner, taken by Arne Maier (Augsburg), comes to nothing.
9' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
8' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for FC Koln.
6' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
5' Augsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
4' One of the players from Augsburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
3' Soren Storks blows his whistle. Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) commits a foul after dangerous play.
1' FC Koln have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
